summary: William A. Forshey, 54, of Austin, Texas, kayaking a private trip on the Arkansas River's Miracle Mile section, got his boat high-centered on a large rock, stepped out onto the shoreline, and was then seen floating downriver; pulled ashore about 200 yards downstream, CPR failed and he was pronounced dead at the scene of drowning.
location: Miracle Mile, Arkansas River, about 7 miles north of Buena Vista
notes: Run 995 Mountain Mail chunk: Mountain Mail article identifying Forshey on Tuesday as the victim who died Monday; article record dated 2014-07-30 pins the Monday to 2014-07-28; Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area said the death was not counted as a boating fatality; assisting agencies included Colorado Parks and Wildlife, Chaffee County Fire Protection District, Chaffee County Search and Rescue, EMS, and the coroner.
